substrate: GEO GSE144621 peak tiles, leave_peak_out, ceiling 0.941

preregistered.question: does rank-averaging the learned conv encoder with the biophysical max_tx scalar beat the scalar alone on the tile rung?

precondition.name: orthogonality
precondition.rule: a naive rank-average lifts only when the modalities are ORTHOGONAL; a near-chance second modality REDUCES the signal (measured: ESM2+ProSST 0.204 vs ESM2 0.352 on CTX-M-14, because ProSST alone was at chance)
precondition.not_a_gate: the orthogonality number is REPORTED, not used to skip the run -- a prediction that a combine will fail is not a substitute for measuring it

preregistered.control: max_tx rank-averaged with a SHUFFLED conv vector; if this lifts, the gain is an artifact of rank-averaging rather than of the conv's content

verdicts.HYBRID_ADDS: paired median >= +0.02 over max_tx AND >= 8/10 seeds win AND control clean
verdicts.WEAK: gain > 0 but below the margin or the seed count
verdicts.NO_GAIN: no positive paired gain -- the learned encoder carries nothing orthogonal here
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_CONTROL_ALSO_LIFTS: the shuffled-conv control lifts too; the combine, not the conv, is producing the number
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_RECONCILE_FAILED: the prediction table's published anchors drift
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_MISSING_SCORER: conv or max_tx absent from the table

honest_limits: The combine is label-free and parameter-free (a rank-average), so it RANKS and does not dose -- the same deployability class as the inverse cell.
Both inputs are out-of-sample on each seed's held-out peaks, so no second-level leakage is introduced; but the pool is MEASURED peak tiles, not generator output.
One rung, one experiment, one combine rule. A negative does not show that no learned representation can add here -- only that THIS encoder, rank-averaged with THIS scalar, does not.
`max_tx` and `conv` are both fitted by ridge on the same split, so their errors may be correlated through the split rather than through the biology.
